testsuite.name: A - Aland Karwan - Creation and text validation
testsuite.details:
Tester: Aland Karwan. SECJ3343 Project 1. Group TaskFlow. Baseline: TaskFlow main@5133a6c. Test basis: README.md TF-REQ-001/002/003/007/008 and the default-only portions of TF-REQ-004/005/006. Code: src/utils/validation.js, tasks.js; src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx, Modal.jsx; src/App.jsx.

Scope: creation workflow, trimmed Unicode text limits, counters, inline errors, cancel and reopen. Member C owns enum/date validation and subsequent status changes; B owns editing/deletion; D owns querying; E owns storage failure/recovery and navigation. Techniques: EP, BVA, Decision Table, State Transition, Use Case, Error Guessing. All cases are designed manual tests, initially Not Run.

Use a dedicated Chrome profile at http://localhost:5173. Before EACH independent case open DevTools Console, run localStorage.removeItem("taskflow_tasks"); localStorage.removeItem("taskflow_tasks_backup"); location.reload(); close DevTools. Leave Dashboard, empty search, All Statuses, All Priorities, Newest first. Unless overridden: title = Write Weekly Report; description empty; priority Medium; status To Do; due date empty. In literal repetition notation, a x N means exactly N copies of ASCII a, with no separators. Use the supplied Console copy expressions to put exact data on the clipboard. Observe toasts immediately (they disappear after 3000 ms). Never clear personal task data.

testcase.name: TC-A-001 - Title length 0
testcase.summary:
TC-A-001 - Title length 0.

Test design technique: EP - empty required-title partition

Requirements: REQ-A-001, REQ-A-005
testcase.preconditions: Use dedicated Chrome profile; TaskFlow at http://localhost:5173 from main@5133a6c. Before this case clear only that profile's taskflow_tasks and taskflow_tasks_backup keys and reload. Dashboard; no search/filters; Newest first. Browser storage writable. Unless specified: Write Weekly Report, empty description/date, Medium, To Do. Observe toast within 3 seconds.

step.actions: + New Task: click the button.
step.expectedresults: Dialog "New Task" opens with "Create Task" and "Cancel".

step.actions: Set Task Title to Write Weekly Report, then In Chrome DevTools Console run copy("a".repeat(0)); close DevTools and paste into Task Title.
step.expectedresults: Task Title counter is "0 / 80"; counter is not red.

step.actions: Click Create Task.
step.expectedresults: "Title is required." appears under Task Title; "New Task" stays open.

step.actions: Inspect localStorage taskflow_tasks and the list after Cancel.
step.expectedresults: No task was saved. "No tasks yet" is shown; no success toast.
